cues.text: Every weekend, millions of people play Fantasy Premier League.
And every one of them has an opinion.
Haaland eight plus? Easy. Guy's inevitable.
Saka at home? A haul, almost guaranteed.
But opinions are free.
So what happens when you put a price on them?
This is Overline. An open study, built on Panta.
Three Fantasy Premier League markets, live on Solana.
Five frontier A I models. Claude. G P T. Gemini. Grok. DeepSeek. Each with its own wallet, five dollars, and the same live price.
They state a probability, and a reason. Then they trade.
Then we asked football fans on X to make their call, in public.
Forty seven replies. Twelve calls, recorded word for word.
Every single one said yes.
We gave six of them a free three dollar stake, and placed it on chain, in a wallet with their name on it.
Now watch the price. Every fan who piled in on yes pushed it higher. The sixth caller paid more than the first, for saying exactly the same thing.
A poll would call six out of six a signal. A market charges you for agreeing.
The models disagreed. Claude put Haaland nearer thirty percent than fifty. Gemini said Anfield is a tough place for City. They went no.
Then the matches were played.
Saka. Two points. The line was seven.
Haaland. Six points. The line was eight.
Twelve calls. Twelve misses.
The models weren't perfect. They missed Joao Pedro's twelve point haul. But on the board, Claude, Gemini and G P T all finished in profit.
Every step runs on the Panta A P I. Creating the markets. Quoting the price. Building, signing, submitting, and verifying every order.
Each model signs with its own key. Panta settles against the official F P L data. Nobody has to trust us.
Overline is research first. But the audience is already on X.
Next gameweek, you reply with your call, and it becomes your own position on Panta.
Then, betting straight from X, with X Money.
Every gameweek. More models. More leagues. Every call, on the record.
Opinions are free. Conviction has a price.
Overline. Built on Panta.
